title.zh: v1.16.14 调音台三处补完：反相可用、主推子真实电平、通道表真实分析器
title.en: v1.16.14 Console completed: working polarity, real master level, real channel meters

highlights.zh: 反相（Ø）真正可用：新增每通道极性级 GainNode（±1），打通数据模型 → 实时引擎 → 离线 WAV 渲染 → 存储（可撤销、随工程持久化）→ 调音台按钮的完整链路；send A/B 也跟随极性
highlights.en: Polarity (Ø) now works end to end: a per-channel ±1 gain stage wired through the data model, realtime engine, offline WAV renderer, store (undoable and persisted) and the console button; the A/B sends follow the polarity too

highlights.zh: 主推子不再猜测：引擎暴露 getMasterVolume() 并把主音量纳入音频设置持久化，调音台挂载时读取真实电平（此前硬编码 0.8）
highlights.en: The master fader no longer guesses: the engine exposes getMasterVolume() and persists the level in audio settings, so the console mounts with the real value instead of a hard-coded 0.8

highlights.zh: 通道电平表改用真实分析器：引擎按需为每通道插入 fftSize=256 的直通分析器（视图卸载即移除），通道表显示真实信号峰值而非音量×声像的估算
highlights.en: Channel meters now read real analysers: the engine inserts a pass-through 256-point analyser per channel on demand (removed when the view unmounts), so the meters show the true signal instead of a volume×pan estimate

highlights.zh: 孤儿审计脚本接入门禁：脚本可查的 159 曲风 + 300 关系 + 11 条时间线故事审计，此前从未被任何流程调用；同时清理 5 个一次性 JS 脚本（scripts/ 由 41 项精简到 17 项）
highlights.en: An orphan audit script is now a real gate: 159 genres + 300 relations + 11 timeline stories, previously never invoked by any pipeline; plus 5 one-off JS scripts removed (scripts/ down from 41 to 17 entries)
